findings.issue: The portable WAIT no-operation cases were missing.
findings.resolution: 12.7.2 p3: 'The value of the expression specified in the ID= specifier shall be zero or the identifier of a pending data transfer operation'. WAIT with ID=0, and with ID= omitted, on an ASYNCHRONOUS='YES' connection with nothing pending must succeed with IOSTAT 0 and take no END/ERR branch.

findings.issue: The ENDFILE position plan used REWIND, destroying the position under test.
findings.resolution: 12.8.3 p2 requires BACKSPACE or REWIND before the next transfer after ENDFILE; BACKSPACE from after the endfile record positions before it, so the next READ must report IOSTAT_END, whereas a neighbouring position would read a data record.
